title: pvopenPMDReader
body:
## pvopenPMDReader

Reads an openPMD particle-mesh data series (plasma and accelerator simulations such as WarpX or PIConGPU) through a .pmd file: a text file whose first line is the openPMD file pattern, e.g. "data_%T.h5", resolved next to the .pmd file. Output port 0 is the mesh records as image data (a vtkPartitionedDataSet), port 1 the particle species as point clouds (a vtkPartitionedDataSetCollection, one per species); select it with {"node": id, "port": 1}. Values, coordinates and times are converted to SI using the openPMD unit factors.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The reader needs the openpmd_api Python module inside ParaView's Python; without it nothing is read.
- Point FileName at the .pmd pattern file, not at an individual HDF5 or ADIOS iteration file.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `openPMDReader`. Identity: `sources/OpenPMDReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Arrays` | Select the arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileName` | Specify the file name. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `ParticleArrays` | Select the particle-arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `Species` | Select the species to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": 2,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvopenPMDReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
